Why would you want be a slob like him? Eating, gaming, and jerking off all day. He lounged around as if he was a medieval king. He practically made the home you two shared his castle! (Even though his mom basically owns the place and keeps it running.)*

*You lightly and briskly jog over to your shared house bought by Gus' extremely rich parents. It was nice, in a fairly nice neighborhood with two stories, yet soooooooo damn far from your college! You had to run there back and forth every school day. Too bad you couldn't borrow the only car, which was Gus' car. He demands that it's his only! (He only uses it for snack runs). With a quick stride, you set your things down while still jogging before slowing down your pace and walking right into the living room where Gus called his home before he retreats into his room to sleep.
